sources.title: Fees
quotes: Fees are based on your rolling 14 day volume and are assessed at the end of each day in UTC.

sources.title: Funding
quotes: The funding rate on Hyperliquid is paid every hour.
For consistency with CEXs, interest rate component is predetermined at 0.01% every 8 hours, which is 0.00125% every hour, or 11.6% APR paid to short.
The funding rate formula applies to 8 hour funding rate. However, funding is paid every hour at one eighth of the computed rate for each hour.
The specific formula is `Funding Rate (F) = Average Premium Index (P) + clamp (interest rate - Premium Index (P), -0.0005, 0.0005)`. The premium is sampled every 5 seconds and averaged over the hour.
Funding on Hyperliquid is capped at 0.5%/hour.

sources.title: Margin tiers
quotes: `maintenance_margin_rate(tier = n) = (Initial Margin Rate at Maximum leverage at tier n) / 2` . For example, at 20x max leverage, `maintenance_margin_rate = 2.5%`.
BTC: 0-150M max leverage 40; >150M 20. ETH: 0-100M 25; >100M 15. SOL: 0-70M 20; >70M 10 (table rows, Mainnet Margin Tiers).

sources.title: Liquidations
quotes: If the account equity drops below 2/3 of the maintenance margin without successful liquidation through the book, a backstop liquidation happens through the liquidator vault.
Unlike CEXs there is no clearance fee on liquidations.
For liquidatable positions larger than 100k USDC (10k USDC on testnet for easier testing), only 20% of the position will be sent as a market liquidation order to the book.

sources.title: Robust price indices
quotes: Oracle prices are updated by the validators approximately once every three seconds.
Mark price is an unbiased and robust estimate of the fair perp price, and is used for margining, liquidations, triggering TP/SL, and computing unrealized pnl.

sources.title: Release Number 8412-21 (BitMEX consent order)
quotes: Cryptocurrency trading platforms conducting business in the U.S. must obtain the appropriate registration, and must implement robust Know-Your-Customer and Anti-Money Laundering procedures.
Thus, the order finds that BitMEX violated the CEA by operating a facility to trade or process swaps without being approved as a Designated Contract Market (DCM) or a Swap Execution Facility (SEF).
BitMEX has certified to the CFTC that anyone located, incorporated, or otherwise established in, or a resident of, the U.S. is prohibited from accessing the BitMEX trading platform

sources.title: Release Number 8715-23 (Ooki DAO default judgment)
quotes: This decision should serve as a wake-up call to anyone who believes they can circumvent the law by adopting a DAO structure, intending to insulate themselves from law enforcement and ultimately putting the public at risk.

The administrative order and this enforcement action charged that bZeroX (and then the Ooki DAO) unlawfully offered leveraged and margined retail commodity transactions outside of a registered exchange, unlawfully acted as an FCM, and unlawfully failed to comply with Bank Secrecy Act obligations applicable to FCMs.
